question: Ana permanently eats 500 kJ a day less. Each 100 kJ a day moves eventual weight about 1 kg. How many kg does she lose?
answer: About 5 kg in all: half within a year, nearly all within three, then her weight settles
move: A body adjusts to a change, so steady effort reaches a new level.
ask: Which change am I expecting to keep paying off forever, when it will level off?
trap: Expecting the same loss again every year, as older rules promised.
hint: Divide the daily cut by the 100 kJ that each kilo needs.
steps: About 5 kg in all: half within a year, nearly all within three, then her weight settles
reference: Hall, Sacks, Chandramohan, Chow, Wang, Gortmaker & Swinburn, Quantification of the effect of energy imbalance on bodyweight, The Lancet, 2011
